test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In a circular race of 1500 m, P and Q start from the same point and at the same time, at speeds of 20 km/h and 35 km/h, respectively. After what time will they meet for the first time on the track if they are running in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance of the circular track = 1500 m

Speed of P = 20 km/h = (20 × 1000) / 3600 = 50 / 9 m/s

Speed of Q = 35 km/h = (35 × 1000) / 3600 = 175 / 18 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time for the first meeting = Circumference of the track / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed (since they are running in the same direction) = Speed of Q - Speed of P

Relative Speed = (175 / 18) - (50 / 9)

Relative Speed = (175 / 18) - (100 / 18)

Relative Speed = (75 / 18)

Relative Speed = 25 / 6 m/s

Time for the first meeting = 1500 / (25 / 6)

⇒ Time = 1500 × (6 / 25)

⇒ Time = 9000 / 25

⇒ Time = 360 seconds

**The time after which P and Q will meet for the first time is 360 seconds.**
